title: Product formula for the Cauchy–Schwarz bound
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer, let $r$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $F$ assign a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to each point of the $r$-dimensional Boolean cube. The recursively defined Gowers Cauchy–Schwarz bound satisfies $\displaystyle \operatorname{CS}_k(F)=\prod_{s\in\{0,1\}^r}\operatorname{diag}_k(F(s))^{1/2^r}$, where $\operatorname{diag}_k(f)$ denotes the diagonal Gowers inner product of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a Gowers family on the $r$-dimensional cube with real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional cube
